summary.text: Kyle Walker is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 31, which covers portions of Hamilton and Marion counties, since 2020.
He is the Assistant Majority Caucus Chair and the ranking member of the Insurance and Financial Institutions and Public Policy committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Walker attended Lawrence North High School and earned a B.S. in business management from Indiana Wesleyan University.

He owns Kyle Walker Consulting, LLC, and previously served as an elected Lawrence City Councilor, as chairman of the Marion County Republican Party and as president of the Fort Harrison Reuse Authority.
He also serves on the Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee and is the Indiana Republican Party's 7th Congressional District vice chair.
The page lists him as a recipient of the Sagamore of the Wabash in 2016 and 2025 and says he has a wife, Jennifer, and two children, Chase and Cameron.
